sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所世界排名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加利福尼亚州及全球各地合作创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这全都是该大学旨在促进所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.ucDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 请访问 21stCentury.ucDavis.edu 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In the world of Philip K.
sentences.zh: 在菲利普·K·

sentences.en: Dick, humans are often at the mercy of objects, like taxis, coffee makers, and doors.
sentences.zh: 迪克的书里，人类常常任由物品摆布，比如出租车、咖啡机和门。

sentences.en: Here's a scene from his book, Ubik.
sentences.zh: 下面是他的书《尤比克》中的一个场景。

sentences.en: The door refused to open.
sentences.zh: 门拒绝打开。

sentences.en: It said, five cents, please.
sentences.zh: 它说，请付五美分。

sentences.en: Joe Chip searched his pockets.
sentences.zh: 乔·奇普搜了搜口袋。

sentences.en: No more coins.
sentences.zh: 没有硬币了。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: I'll pay you tomorrow, he told the door.
sentences.zh: 我明天付你钱，他对门说。

sentences.en: Again, he tried the knob.
sentences.zh: 他又去扭动门把手。

sentences.en: Again, it remained locked tight.
sentences.zh: 它依然锁得死死的。

sentences.en: From the drawer besides the sink, Joe got a stainless steel knife.
sentences.zh: 从水槽旁的抽屉里，乔拿出一把不锈钢刀。

sentences.en: With it, he began systematically to unscrew the bolt assembly of his money-gulping door.
sentences.zh: 他用这把刀开始系统性地拆卸他那吞钱的门的螺栓组件。

sentences.en: I'll sue you, the door said, as the first screw fell out.
sentences.zh: 我要起诉你，门随着第一颗螺丝的掉落说道。

sentences.en: That's Benjamin Walker.
sentences.zh: 那是本杰明·沃克。

sentences.en: He told me he's always subscribed to Dick's dystopian vision of man versus object.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他一直笃信迪克关于人与物对抗的反乌托邦愿景。

sentences.en: But then, he met up with Paola Antonelli.
sentences.zh: 但随后，他遇到了保拉·安东内利。

sentences.en: Philip K.
sentences.zh: 菲利普·K·

sentences.en: Dick's view of the future of objects was definitely dystopian,
sentences.zh: 迪克对物品未来的看法绝对是反乌托邦的，

sentences.en: and he needed it for, like, drama reasons.
sentences.zh: 而且他这么写，可以说是出于戏剧效果的需要。

sentences.en: But in truth, we've had a report with objects throughout the centuries.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，几个世纪以来，我们一直与物品保持着某种关系。

sentences.en: I mean, there's always been affection, emotion, heirloom ring, or the bridge where you had your first kiss.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一直以来都有喜爱、情感、传家宝戒指，或者那个你初吻的桥。

sentences.en: I mean, there's always been an attachment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一直以来都有一种依恋。

sentences.en: There's a whole universe in every single object that becomes even bigger when put in relationship with a person.
sentences.zh: 每个单一物品中都包含着整个宇宙，当它与人建立联系时，这个宇宙甚至会变得更大。

sentences.en: Paola Antonelli is a senior curator in the Department of Architecture and Design at the Museum of Modern Art.
sentences.zh: 保拉·安东内利是现代艺术博物馆建筑与设计部的资深策展人。

sentences.en: Her most recent blockbuster show, Talk to Me, examined the future and the history of communication design.
sentences.zh: 她最近轰动一时的展览《和我对话》，审视了通信设计的未来与历史。

sentences.en: Furniture design or car design is just one fragment of the design world.
sentences.zh: 家具设计或汽车设计只是设计世界的一个碎片。

sentences.en: And for many years, there's been something called communication design,
sentences.zh: 多年来，一直存在着一种叫做通信设计的东西，

sentences.en: which maybe before used to be called graphic design, which is the design of messages,
sentences.zh: 也许以前被称为平面设计，也就是信息的传达设计，

sentences.en: be it advertising or be it, you know, just signage.
sentences.zh: 无论是广告还是，你知道的，仅仅是标牌。

sentences.en: So, it's existed.
sentences.zh: 所以，它一直都存在。

sentences.en: So, that's design whose subject is communication.
sentences.zh: 因此，那是主题为沟通的设计。

sentences.en: But, right now, the difference is that even furniture designers need to understand
sentences.zh: 但是，现在不同的是，连家具设计师都需要明白，

sentences.en: that a chair might need to have some kind of conversation with people.
sentences.zh: 一把椅子可能需要与人们进行某种形式的对话。

sentences.en: There was a talking chair in her show.
sentences.zh: 她的展览里有一把会说话的椅子。

sentences.en: This is the era in which chairs can talk.
sentences.zh: 这是一个椅子可以说话的时代。

sentences.en: If they can talk, they can sing.
sentences.zh: 如果它们会说话，它们就能唱歌。

sentences.en: And talking toys and talking maps.
sentences.zh: 还有会说话的玩具和会说话的地图。

sentences.en: But there were also ATMs and subway kiosks.
sentences.zh: 但其中也有自动取款机和地铁亭。

sentences.en: According to Paola Antonelli, cutting-edge communication design is all about the interface.
sentences.zh: 保拉·安东内利认为，最前沿的通信设计完全关乎交互界面。

sentences.en: When you say interface, you can take out the face and put section.
sentences.zh: 当你说道面（face）这个词时，你可以去掉它，换成截面（section）。

sentences.en: You can take out section and put relation.
sentences.zh: 你也可以去掉截面，换成关系（relation）。

sentences.en: I mean, it's one of the focal points of the way we live today and the way culture moves today.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们今天的生活方式以及文化发展方式的焦点之一。

sentences.en: Paola Antonelli says designers understand the interface between people and objects
sentences.zh: 保拉·安东内利说，设计师对人与物之间交互界面的理解，

sentences.en: better than, say, science fiction writers because what they're really working on
sentences.zh: 比方说，要比科幻小说作家更透彻，因为他们真正致力于研究的，

sentences.en: is the interface between people and people.
sentences.zh: 其实是人与人之间的交互界面。

sentences.en: One of the pieces she put in her show was a menstruation machine designed by Sputnikko.
sentences.zh: 她放在展里的作品之一是一台由 Sputnikko 设计的月经机。

sentences.en: And in that particular case, the interface is not between man and machine.
sentences.zh: 在那种特定情况下，交互界面并非存在于人与机器之间。

sentences.en: It's between man and woman, right?
sentences.zh: 而是存在于男人与女人之间，对吧？

sentences.en: So, it's a contraption that looks like a chastity belt that it's for men, but also for menopausal
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个看起来像贞操带的小玩意儿，它是为男人准备的，但也适用于绝经期的

sentences.en: women.
sentences.zh: 女性。

sentences.en: And it really gives you the feeling of a menstruation.
sentences.zh: 它真的能给你带来月经的感觉。

sentences.en: It has electrodes that stimulate your lower abdomen and they give you cramps.
sentences.zh: 它有电极可以刺激你的下腹部，并给你带来痉挛。

sentences.en: And then it has a reservoir in the back.
sentences.zh: 然后它后面有一个储液器。

sentences.en: You're supposed to draw your blood, put it in there, and then you have your blood drip
sentences.zh: 你应该抽出自己的血，把它放进去，然后让你的血

sentences.en: exactly where it should.
sentences.zh: 准确地滴落到它该去的地方。

sentences.en: So, it's the whole shebang.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是整个流程。

sentences.en: And to me, it's the ultimate gesture of understanding.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是理解的终极姿态。

sentences.en: And that's what I really love.
sentences.zh: 这也是我真正热爱的地方。

sentences.en: That interface, not the human-machine interface.
sentences.zh: 那种交互界面，而不是人机交互界面。

sentences.en: The human-machine interface, you know what?
sentences.zh: 人机交互界面，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We are all doing, engineers, designers, scientists, we're all trying to make technology disappear.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都在做，工程师、设计师、科学家，我们都在努力让技术消失。

sentences.en: That's the truth.
sentences.zh: 这就是事实。

sentences.en: Just like we go through the tollbooths in freeways using E-ZPass, and we still have that box, but
sentences.zh: 就像我们使用 E-ZPass 通过高速公路的收费站一样，我们身上虽然还有那个盒子，但

sentences.en: we don't think about it.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不去想它。

sentences.en: That's how life should be, so that we can focus on real human habits and human needs, as opposed
sentences.zh: 生活本该如此，这样我们就能专注于真正的人类习惯和人类需求，而不是

sentences.en: to focusing on the technology.
sentences.zh: 把注意力放在技术上。

sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由本杰明·沃克制作，他制作了 WFMU 的广播节目《太多

sentences.en: Information from WFMU.
sentences.zh: 信息》。

sentences.zh: 而且他的胳膊上还纹了一个受菲利普·K·

sentences.en: Dick-inspired Ubik tattoo on his arm.
sentences.zh: 迪克启发的《尤比克》纹身。

sentences.zh: 本节目的制作得到了 Lunar 的支持，用创造力创造不同。

sentences.zh: 这是旧金山本地公共广播电台 KALW 91.7、旧金山

sentences.zh: 美国建筑师学会以及建筑与设计中心的合作项目。

sentences.zh: 本节目由公共广播交流平台 PRX 发行，致力于让公共广播更加普及，

sentences.zh: 我们的实习生是萨姆·格林斯潘。
